description: Manages settings for a UniFi site. Configure only the settings you need by providing the corresponding nested object.

attribute.description: USG settings.
Enable broadcast ping.
DNS verification settings.
Domain for DNS verification.
Primary DNS server.
Secondary DNS server.
Setting preference: auto or manual.
Enable FTP module.
Geo IP filtering action: block or allow.
Comma-separated list of country codes for geo IP filtering.
Enable geo IP filtering.
Geo IP filtering traffic direction: both, ingress, or egress.
Enable GRE module.
Enable H.323 module.
ICMP connection timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `30s`, `1m`).
MSS clamping mode: auto, custom, or disabled.
Enable hardware offload for accounting.
Enable hardware offload for L2 blocking.
Enable hardware offload for scheduling.
Other connections timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `600s`, `10m`).
Enable PPTP module.
Accept ICMP redirects.
Send ICMP redirects.
Enable SIP module.
Enable SYN cookies.
TCP close timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `10s`).
TCP close wait timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `60s`, `1m`).
TCP established connection timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `7440s`, `2h4m`).
TCP fin wait timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `120s`, `2m`).
TCP last ACK timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `30s`).
TCP SYN received timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `60s`, `1m`).
TCP SYN sent timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `120s`, `2m`).
TCP time wait timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `120s`, `2m`).
Enable TFTP module.
Timeout setting preference: auto or manual.
UDP other timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `30s`).
UDP stream timeout, as a Go duration string (e.g. `180s`, `3m`).
Unbind WAN monitors.
Enable UPnP.
Enable UPnP NAT-PMP.
Enable UPnP secure mode.
UPnP WAN interface (e.g., WAN, WAN2).
Remote syslog (rsyslogd) settings.
Logged facilities (e.g. `device`, `client`, `firewall_default_policy`, `triggers`, `updates`, `admin_activity`, `critical`, `security_detections`, `vpn`).
Enable debug logging.
Whether remote syslog is enabled.
Remote syslog server IP address.
Log all available facilities.
Whether netconsole logging is enabled.
Netconsole host.
Netconsole port (1-65535).
Remote syslog server port (1-65535).
Also log this controller's events.
Only send this controller's logs over an encrypted channel.

Intrusion Prevention System (IPS/IDS) and threat management settings. Basic IDS/IPS uses the built-in Emerging Threats ruleset and is free. A UniFi CyberSecure subscription adds enhanced threat intelligence from Proofpoint and Cloudflare on top of the base ruleset.
Advanced filtering mode: manual or disabled.
Show a blocking page when content filtering blocks a request.
Emerging Threats ruleset categories to enable (e.g. "emerging-malware", "tor", "phishing").
Network IDs to apply IPS inspection to.
Honeypot IP addresses per network.
IP address to use as a honeypot.
Network ID this honeypot IP belongs to.
IP version: v4 or v6.
Enable honeypot to detect internal port scans.
IPS operating mode: ids (detect only), ips (detect and block), ipsInline, or disabled.
Use memory-optimized IPS ruleset (reduced rule set for low-memory devices).
Block BitTorrent traffic.
IPS signature alert suppression entries — silence specific signatures or categories.
Alert suppression signature category.
Signature Generator ID (GID).
Signature ID.
Suppression signature name.
Tracking specifications (used when `type` is `track`).
Match direction: both, src, or dest.
Match mode: ip, subnet, or network.
IP address, CIDR subnet, or network ID to match.
Suppression type: `all` (everywhere) or `track` (only the tracked sources/destinations).
IPS suppression whitelist entries — sources/destinations to exclude from inspection.
Match direction: both, src, or dest.
Match mode: ip, subnet, or network.
IP address, CIDR subnet, or network ID to whitelist.
LCD/display (LCM) settings for devices with a screen.
Display brightness (1-100).
Whether the device display is enabled.
Seconds of inactivity before the display turns off (10-3600).
Sync display settings across devices.
Whether touch events on the display are enabled.
RADIUS settings.
Enable RADIUS accounting.
RADIUS accounting port.
RADIUS authentication port.
Enable the site's RADIUS server. A VPN server that authenticates against RADIUS (`unifi_vpn_server` with `openvpn` or `l2tp`) is rejected with `api.err.RadiusServerNotEnabled` while this is off.
Interim update interval, as a Go duration string (e.g. `1h`, `3600s`).
RADIUS shared secret.

custom.schema_definition: stringvalidator.RegexMatches(regexp.MustCompile(`^[^\\\ "']+$`), "must not contain backslashes, spaces, single quotes, or double quotes")

attribute.description: Encrypted DNS (DNS-over-HTTPS) settings.
Custom DNS servers specified via DNS stamp.
Enable this custom server. Defaults to true.
DNS stamp (sdns://) for the custom resolver.
Human-readable name for this custom server.
Predefined DNS provider names (e.g. "cloudflare", "google").
Encrypted DNS state: off, auto, manual, or custom.
Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) settings.
Whether DPI is enabled.
Whether device fingerprinting is enabled.
Management settings.
Enable advanced features.
Automatically upgrade device firmware.
Hour of day (0-23) for automatic firmware upgrades.
Enable debug tools.
Enable Direct Connect (remote access).
Allow SSH password authentication (in addition to keys).
Enable SSH authentication.
SSH keys.
Comment.
Public SSH key.
Name of SSH key.
Type of SSH key, e.g. ssh-rsa.
SSH password for device access. Sensitive — the controller stores only a hash, so this value is kept from configuration and not read back.
SSH username for device access.
Enable the UniFi Identity Provider.
Enable WiFiman.
NTP (time server) settings.
Primary NTP server. An empty string clears it — the controller stores and returns the literal empty value.
Second NTP server. An empty string clears it — the controller stores and returns the literal empty value.
Third NTP server. An empty string clears it — the controller stores and returns the literal empty value.
Fourth NTP server. An empty string clears it — the controller stores and returns the literal empty value.
Configuration mode: `auto` or `manual`.
Regulatory country settings.
Regulatory country code (ISO 3166-1 numeric).
Periodic automated internet speed test settings.
Cron expression controlling when the speed test runs (e.g. `0 * * * *`).
Whether periodic automated speed tests are enabled.

Site-level IGMP snooping setting. On UniFi Network 10.3.x+ the effective IGMP snooping toggle lives here rather than on each network. Advanced querier/flood options configured in the UI are preserved across updates.
Whether IGMP snooping is enabled for the site. Enabling it only takes effect when `network_ids` names a network.
IDs of the networks IGMP snooping applies to.
Automated network optimization settings.
Whether automated network optimization is enabled.
Site locale settings.
Site timezone (IANA time zone name, e.g. `America/Los_Angeles`).
Global NAT (network address translation) settings.
IDs of networks excluded from global NAT.
Global NAT mode: `auto`, `custom`, or `off`.
SSL inspection settings.
SSL inspection state: `off`, `simple`, or `advanced`.
IPsec settings for site-to-site VPNs.
IKEv2 re-authentication method for site-to-site VPNs (observed: `make-before-break`).
Dashboard layout and widget visibility settings.
Dashboard layout mode: `auto` or `manual`.
Dashboard widget visibility overrides.
Whether this widget is shown on the dashboard.
Which dashboard widget this override applies to.
Ethernet port lighting color settings.
Per-network Ethernet port lighting color overrides.
ID of the network this color override applies to.
Hex color code for this override (e.g. `FF0000`).
Per-link-speed Ethernet port lighting color overrides.
Link speed this color override applies to.
Hex color code for this override (e.g. `FF0000`).
Global network settings for zone-based firewalling.
Site-wide default security posture used by zone-based firewalling (observed: `ALLOW_ALL`).
Traffic flow classification settings.
Enable the allowed-traffic list for traffic flow classification.
Route traffic flow classification through the gateway's own DNS.
Classify traffic to and from UniFi device management as its own traffic flow.
Classify traffic to and from UniFi cloud services as its own traffic flow.
mDNS (multicast DNS / Bonjour) repeater settings.
mDNS repeater mode: `all` (repeat every predefined service), `auto` (controller-managed discovery) or `custom` (only the services named in predefined_services/custom_services).
Custom mDNS services to repeat. Only consulted by the controller when mode is `custom`.
mDNS service type, e.g. `_myservice._tcp.local`.
Display name for this custom service.
Predefined mDNS services to repeat. Only consulted by the controller when mode is `custom`.
Code identifying a predefined mDNS service.
The ID of the settings.
The name of the site to associate the settings with.
